scope: Local resources used by the current website Bible Study section.
status: Resource sizing and About Developer preview only; Android app/installer not built.

plan.offline: Shared study resources provided with installation
plan.accounts: Free for existing account holders using the existing Sheets-backed website login
plan.sync: Optional online synchronization with existing website/Google Drive
plan.permissions: Owner confirms permission for all resources
plan.guest_access: Earlier guest-access request is retained for discussion; this audit does not change it.

components.name: Bible texts and main study resources
components.basis: Existing local database file, including dictionaries, embedded images, language resources, BE commentary, local commentary, book studies and local sermon outlines.

components.name: Library commentary and sermon sources: 79 books
components.basis: Actual temporary SQLite export of study-only documents, chunks and formatting, preserving existing table schemas and ordinary indexes. Passed quick_check; temporary database deleted.

components.name: Reader interface, fonts, icons and referenced images
components.basis: Explicit current website interface asset manifest; excludes Android runtime.

components.name: About Developer profiles, portraits and preview
components.basis: Staged files with the two completed developer profiles.

components.name: Provided app icon and splash-screen source images
components.basis: Existing Images folder in the requested app directory.

provisional_allowance.status: Planning estimates only; replace with measured release-build requirements.

limitations: This is an exact byte count for the listed resource baseline, not a measurement of a finished Android installation or compressed download.

The existing Bible and illustration database file sizes are counted unchanged. The release export must remove all personal reading state/history. Personal sermon notes and all church account databases/credentials are excluded from the shared installation.

The 79 selected library documents match the currently active, visible public sources used by the website commentary/sermon providers. The 42 Exalting Jesus books, 1 Moody book, 9 Pulpit volumes and 36 sermon sources overlap by 9 Pulpit volumes. BE/Wiersbe and locally imported resources are already counted in the main Bible database.
Original PDFs/EPUBs are import sources; ordinary indexed study readers do not need a second copy of them. Whole-library ebook browsing outside Bible Study is outside this audit.

Existing derived caches include obsolete/duplicate fingerprints and are excluded. Fresh caches, new search indexes, Android runtime/native libraries, small sanitized public book metadata, installer compression/extraction and installation/update workspace are not measured yet.
Only locally available indexed content was audited. No Google Drive synchronization or downloads were performed.
The final Android download size, installed size and minimum installation free-space requirement must be measured from the release build. Provisional planning allowances are not tested minimums.
